τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τλήμων: τλήμων — enduring, steadfast, stout-hearted (root of τλῆναι ’endure’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
τοίους: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. pl.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τρώεσσ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, elided (Τρώεσσ’ = Τρώεσσι), after ἐπαμύνω
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδεω: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus (patronymic of Diomedes); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόξῳ: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. sg., after πέλασεν: ’to the bow’
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’

τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so she spoke’
φάτνῃ: φάτνη — manger, crib, stall; fem. dat. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φωνησάσης: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak aloud; aor. part. act. fem. gen. sg.: ’who had spoken’
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, space; masc. acc. sg.
ἀέκοντε: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. nom. dual, uncontracted (= Attic ἄκοντε)
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνης: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀθήνῃ: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Ἀθηνᾷ)
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it · also adv. in tmesis with ἕπον: ’around’ (ἀμφί … ἕπον ’dressed’)
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’ · also masc. nom. dual, in apposition to a dual subject (τὼ … ἀμφοτέρω ’the two, both’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’

ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργυρότοξος: ἀργυρότοξος — of the silver bow; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Apollo
ἀσπαίροντας: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. act., masc. acc. pl.: ’gasping’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφυσσόμενοι: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀφύττω): ’drawing’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’willing’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)

ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπέστη: ἐφίστημι — set upon; aor. 3 sg. act. intrans.: ’stood beside, stood over’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -σετο (= Attic ἐπέβη): ’mounted’
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon, advance against; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’advancing’

ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro, go round to; go at, attack; impf. 3 sg.
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg. act.
ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’good’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’a good man’ (οὐ κακὸν οὐδὲ μὲν ἐσθλόν ’neither a base nor a good man’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’)
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)

ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking’

ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔκτανε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist ἔκτανον: ’killed’
ἔλθῃς: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 2 sg., after εἰς ὅ κεν: ’until you come’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔναρα: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from a slain foe; neut. acc. pl., object of φέροι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεσσί: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι; accent from the enclitic τε)

ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc., accented ἔς before an enclitic

ἱδρῶ: ἱδρώς — sweat; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἱδρῶτα)
ἱμᾶσι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. pl., of means: ’with straps’

ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ὀΐεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀρυμαγδοῦ: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar; masc. gen. sg.
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄναρ: ὄναρ — dream, vision seen in sleep (opposed to ὕπαρ); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὄρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; mid. rise, start up; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented and elided (ὄρνυτ’ = ὄρνυτο)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκέες: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκυπόδων: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc./fem. gen. pl., epithet of horses
ὠκύποδες: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
